items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: I used to go down and play with Red Mack, the trumpet player and vibist -- we used to go in there and play with him.

ctx.x: I don't know the people who ran the Cafe Society. But then they had another little place down the street on San Pedro and Jefferson where I used to go down and play with Red Mack, the trumpet player and vibist -- we used to go in there and play with him. And Tom Archia, a very fine saxophone player from eastern Texas; I played with him the Howard McGhee band later on.
And down around the First and San Pedro area, they had Shepp's Playhouse. Gerald Wilson's big band was upstairs, and they had smaller combos downstairs, you know.
